zh.title: 水果拼盘大作战
zh.task: 找出家里至少3种当季水果，发挥想象力摆一个有趣的拼盘，拍照留念

en.title: Fruit Arrangement Art
en.task: Arrange at least 3 seasonal fruits into a creative pattern, snap a photo

zh.title: 发现日常角落
zh.task: 在家附近找一个从未注意过的角落或小路，用手机记录5个有趣的细节

en.title: Discover hidden corners
en.task: Walk to an unexplored spot near your home and capture 5 interesting details you've never noticed before with your phone

zh.title: 观察生活的隐喻
zh.task: 用手机拍下上班或上学路上最特别的一个细节，写一句20字以内的简短解读

en.title: Spot the metaphor
en.task: Photograph one unusual detail on your commute and write a one-sentence caption under 20 words

zh.title: 记录夏日落日
zh.task: 傍晚找一个视野好的地方，观察并用手机记录今天日落前后的天空颜色变化

en.title: Capture sunset
en.task: Find a spot with a good view tonight and capture the sky colors before and after sunset with your phone

zh.title: 捕捉夕阳光影
zh.task: 在日落前后30分钟内，出门找一个有光影对比的角落，用手机拍一张有故事感的照片

en.title: Chase Golden Hour
en.task: Within 30 minutes before or after sunset, go outside and capture a photo with dramatic light and shadow in a corner of your neighborhood

zh.title: 给云朵起个名
zh.task: 找一个视野好的位置，仰望天空5分钟，选一朵云，发挥想象给它起个名字

en.title: Name a Cloud
en.task: Find a spot with a good view of the sky, gaze up for 5 minutes, pick a cloud and give it a creative name

zh.title: 夏日胶囊拼贴
zh.task: 翻出家中的收据、车票或落叶，在一张纸上拼贴一张专属于今年夏天的迷你画。

en.title: Summer Capsule Collage
en.task: Gather receipts, tickets, or fallen leaves at home and glue a tiny collage that captures this summer.

zh.title: 夏日口袋册
zh.task: 用A4纸折成四页口袋册，每页记录这个夏天的一个词、一种颜色、一句气味、一笔速写。

en.title: Summer Pocket Zine
en.task: Fold an A4 paper into a 4-page pocket zine; each page captures this summer with a word, a color, a scent line, and a quick sketch.

zh.title: 夏日拼贴
zh.task: 翻出旧杂志，剪出5个代表这个夏天的词或图，拼成一页告别海报。

en.title: Summer Collage
en.task: Rummage through old magazines, cut out five words or images that capture this summer, and arrange them into a one-page farewell poster.

zh.title: 拼贴一句话
zh.task: 从旧杂志或报纸上剪下5-8个字，拼成一句你想对自己说的话，贴在你明天会看到的地方

en.title: Cut-Out Message
en.task: Cut 5–8 characters from an old magazine or newspaper, arrange them into a message for yourself, and post it where you'll see it tomorrow.

zh.title: 给夏天写封短信
zh.task: 用一张纸写一封给这个夏天的告别信（3-5句话），折成任意形状，拍照留念。

en.title: A Letter to Summer
en.task: Write a 3–5 sentence goodbye letter to this summer on a piece of paper, fold it into any shape, and snap a photo of it.

zh.title: 落叶拼图
zh.task: 捡3片形状各异的落叶，在纸上拼成你喜欢的小图案，拍照留念

en.title: Leaf Collage
en.task: Gather 3 differently shaped fallen leaves, arrange them into a small picture on paper, and snap a photo

zh.title: 为照片写诗
zh.task: 挑一张手机里最近的照片，为它写一首三行小诗，押不押韵都行

en.title: Poem for a Photo
en.task: Pick a recent photo on your phone and write a three-line micro poem for it—rhyme optional

zh.title: 盲盒舞动15分
zh.task: 随机播放一首从没听过的快歌，关掉灯，跟着节奏自由舞动15分钟，不用好看。

en.title: Blind Dance Break
en.task: Shuffle a song you've never heard, turn off the lights, and free-dance to it for 15 minutes—no skill required.

zh.title: 拾一缕夏声
zh.task: 用手机录下一分钟窗外的夏末声音（蝉鸣、晚风或雨声），再为它写一首三行小诗。

en.title: Capture a Summer Sound
en.task: Record one minute of late-summer ambient sound outside your window (cicadas, evening breeze, or rain), then write a three-line poem inspired by it.

zh.title: 夏天书页
zh.task: 用纸写下这个夏天三个闪亮瞬间，折好夹进一本书里，等冬天再翻出。

en.title: Summer Bookmark
en.task: Jot down three bright moments from this summer on paper, fold them up, and tuck them into a book to rediscover next winter.

zh.title: 物件传记
zh.task: 挑一件厨房里的物品，用三段话为它写一段「前世今生」的小传记。

en.title: Object Biography
en.task: Pick one item from your kitchen and write a short three-paragraph past-life story imagining its journey to you.

zh.title: 秋日剪贴
zh.task: 翻一本旧杂志，剪下带有暖色调的图案，拼成一张秋日小画。

en.title: Autumn Collage
en.task: Flip through an old magazine, cut out warm-toned images, and arrange them into a small autumn artwork.

zh.title: 光的变奏
zh.task: 用手机给同一件物品拍3张不同光影下的照片，排列成三联画保存。

en.title: Light Variations
en.task: Photograph one object under three different lighting conditions and arrange the shots as a triptych.

zh.title: 15秒的惦记
zh.task: 挑一位三个月没联系的老朋友，发一条15秒语音，只说一句'突然想到你'。

en.title: A 15-Second Ping
en.task: Pick a friend you haven't talked to in months. Send them a 15-second voice note that just says, 'Just thought of you.'

zh.title: 脚底地图
zh.task: 脱掉鞋袜，赤脚走一遍家里的木地板、地砖和地毯，记下脚底最舒服的那一小块是哪儿。

en.title: Sole Map
en.task: Kick off your shoes and socks, then walk barefoot across the wood, tile, and carpet at home — note which small patch feels the coziest underfoot.

zh.title: 递一份小甜
zh.task: 从家里挑一样多出来的水果或零食，下楼时带给常去小店的人，说一句"这个给你尝尝"。

en.title: A Little Treat
en.task: Grab an extra fruit or snack from home and hand it to someone at your usual little shop on your way out, saying "this one's for you."

zh.title: 口袋考古
zh.task: 翻翻口袋和钱包里的收据、便签，挑一张最不起眼的贴到镜子边，让它多活一天。

en.title: Pocket Archaeology
en.task: Rummage through the receipts and notes in your pockets and wallet, pick the most forgettable one, and stick it to the edge of your mirror so it gets another day of life.

zh.title: 脚趾抓布
zh.task: 地上铺一条小毛巾，光脚用脚趾一根根把它抓起再放下，反复5分钟。

en.title: Toe Grip
en.task: Lay a small towel on the floor and use your toes to grip and release it, repeating for 5 minutes.

zh.title: 低头猎奇
zh.task: 出门走5分钟，低头找三个平时会忽略的地面细节，回来用手指在桌上比划出它们的样子。

en.title: Ground Hunt
en.task: Walk for 5 minutes with your eyes on the ground, find three tiny details you'd normally step over, then trace their shapes on a table with your finger.

zh.title: 加购清点
zh.task: 打开购物App的收藏夹，挑一件加了最久没下单的——今天给它一个了结：付款或划掉。

en.title: Wishlist Audit
en.task: Open your shopping app's wishlist, pick the item you've saved longest—today, pay for it or delete it.

zh.title: 便签写谢
zh.task: 在便利贴上写'谢谢___'填一件具体的事，今天悄悄贴到对方的桌面或物品上。

en.title: Note of Thanks
en.task: On a sticky note, write 'Thanks for ___' naming one specific thing, and quietly stick it on their desk or belongings today.

zh.title: 换路回家
zh.task: 挑一个常走的路口故意拐另一条路，多走10分钟，看到从没进过的店就进去转一圈。

en.title: Detour Home
en.task: At a familiar intersection, deliberately turn down a road you never take, walk 10 extra minutes, and step inside one shop you've never entered.

zh.title: 筷子夹豆
zh.task: 桌上撒一小把花生米或豆子，用筷子一颗颗夹到碗里，数一数两分钟夹了几颗。

en.title: Chopstick Bean Pick
en.task: Scatter a handful of peanuts or beans on the table, then use chopsticks to pick them up one by one into a bowl — count how many you move in two minutes.
